observations.content: User asked whether they got scope wrong porting extensions and to audit which tools/skills/extensions have scope confusion from name collisions or overlapping functionality.

Conclusion formed: the subagent-types port carried a 2-way channel design that does not exist upstream, importing UX expectations from the interactive-subagents extension into a port of pi-subagents; the design comment said agreed-with-user but was never battle-tested upstream.

Extension provenance headers (from grep): ask-user-question.ts is an RPC-compatible fork of amosblomqvist/pi-config extension with deliberate differences; quiz.ts is an RPC-compatible fork of amosblomqvist/learn quiz extension with same grading semantics and deliberate differences; md-log.ts was modeled on the .md-link extension; snip is an RPC-compatible port of amosblomqvist/pi-config prompt-snippets; subagent-types is a role-typed subagents-over-Paseo port of the amosblomqvist subagents repo; web-fetch imports from @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent.

subagent-types/agents contains 6 roles including mermaid-maker, learn-researcher, researcher, scout; upstream pi-subagents has only scout/researcher/worker, so 3 extra roles (mermaid-maker, svg-maker, learn-researcher) were added during the port.

Role model pins: scout.md uses cli-openai/mmcp/MiniMax-M3 thinking high; researcher.md, learn-researcher.md, mermaid-maker.md use cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3-flash; mermaid-maker uses thinking max and tools write_mermaid, edit_mermaid, render_mermaid, read; learn-researcher has tools web_search, web_fetch, safe_bash, system-prompt append, auto-exit true.

Fetched https://github.com/amosblomqvist/pi-config: it lists separate repos pi-interactive-subagents, pi-observational-memory, pi-dictate, learn (user's AI learning system); extensions ask-user-question, bash-guard, browser, custom-header, interactive-subagents stub, observational-memory stub, prompt-snippets, web-fetch, web-search; skills analyze-sessions, pdf-reader, web-debug, youtube-transcript; deprecated/ holds extensions and skills no longer in active use.
Upstream pi-config web-fetch requires npm install; youtube-transcript needs yt-dlp and ffmpeg; pdf-reader needs python3 venv at ~/.pi/agent/skills/pdf-reader/.venv with requirements.txt installed.

Audit mapping: ask-user-question, quiz, snip are clean documented forks; md-log is a modeled-on rewrite with no upstream to track fixes against (mild lineage risk); visual-tools has no lineage marker and is custom for the Obsidian/teach pipeline; web-fetch imports @mariozechner packages looking like a near-verbatim copy; observational-memory ported near-verbatim per HANDOFF; subagent-types is the scope-confusion case.

Skills mapping: analyze-sessions rebuilt for Paseo (paseo_*.py) with old native-pi scripts kept as leftovers inside skills in disabled-pi-scripts/; pdf-reader and youtube-transcript are clean upstream copies; teach is custom based on user's personally verified principles; visualize is custom pairing with visual-tools.

Identified tool-level overlaps: web_fetch built-in pi tool vs web-fetch extension tool name collision; fetch_content vs web_fetch harness duplication; quiz vs ask_user_question functional cousins already cross-contaminated by known Paseo bug #3 title-heuristic; researcher vs learn-researcher near-duplicate roles.

web-fetch/index.ts:548 registers pi.registerTool with name web_fetch, label Web Fetch, description about Readability + Turndown HTML to markdown, handles PDFs, plain text, falls back to Jina Reader for JS-rendered pages; no ui.* RPC-unsafe usage found.

grep for safe_bash registration in subagent-types/index.ts found nothing; visual-tools/index.ts header reveals it registers custom subagent tools with the globally-loaded interactive-subagents extension via globalThis.__pi_interactive_subagents registerToolExtension, and no-ops if interactive-subagents is not loaded.

Major finding: visual-tools' documented host is the interactive-subagents extension (tmux-based) but the workspace actually loads subagent-types (ported from pi-subagents), so visual-tools' header describes a different host than what is loaded.

A diff of researcher.md vs learn-researcher.md showed both are Web researcher roles with same description searching the web and synthesizing findings; learn-researcher adds safe_bash to tools and sets system-prompt append and auto-exit true with a short body versus researcher's long 40-plus-line body, confirming near-duplicate role functionality.

grep across all extensions found no other file hosting __pi_subagents, visual-tools, or CUSTOM_TOOL_EXTENSIONS; the only safe_bash source is ./subagent-types/safe-bash.ts; pi built-in docs extensions.md contains no safe_bash reference.
